about.title: About Us
about.paragraph1: Leaf & Cup started with a simple thought: tea is not just a drink, but a reason to pause and take your time. We collect loose leaf tea varieties, ceramics, and teapots from small producers who value taste and quality as much as we do.
about.paragraph2: From light green to rich dark oolong — the catalog contains only what we brew at home. We select cups and teapots so that they serve for years, not just one season.
about.newsletterDescription: Be the first to know about new tea varieties, sets, and promotions.

contact.title: Contacts
contact.description: Have a question about a product, order, or delivery? Write to us — we usually reply within 1-2 business days.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.notice: Leaf & Cup is an educational demo project. The form below describes a typical approach to personal data processing for an online store and is not related to actual user data collection.
privacy.s1Content: During registration and checkout, we may collect: first and last name, email, delivery address, phone number, and order history. Some technical data (IP address, browser type, cookies) is collected automatically for the site to function.
privacy.s2Content: Data is used for processing and delivering orders, account operation, responding to support requests, and — with your consent — for sending newsletters about new teas and promotions.
privacy.s3Content1: We use only strictly necessary cookies — without them, account login and shopping cart will not work. The site does not set advertising, analytical or marketing cookies, therefore explicit consent is not requested for them — by law it is not required for strictly necessary cookies, but we still warn about their use with a banner on the first visit.
privacy.s3Content2: You can restrict the use of cookies in your browser settings, but then account login and shopping cart will not work.
privacy.tCartId: Links the cart to the device without logging into an account
privacy.s4Content: Data is stored no longer than necessary for processing purposes, and is protected by technical and organizational measures against unauthorized access, modification or loss.
privacy.s5Content: We transfer data to third-party services only to the extent necessary to provide the service: payment systems for processing payments and delivery services for transferring the order. We do not sell personal data to third parties.
privacy.s6Content: You have the right to request access to your data, its correction or deletion, and to withdraw your consent to processing at any time by writing to us at the address below.
privacy.s7Content: We may update this policy from time to time. The date of the last change is indicated at the beginning of the page.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.notice: Leaf & Cup is an educational demo project. Real orders, payment and delivery are not carried out, and the texts below are provided for informational purposes as a typical example of conditions for an online store.
terms.s1Content: By using the Leaf & Cup website, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree with any clause, please do not use the site.
terms.s2Content: Registration may be required to place an order. You agree to provide accurate data and are responsible for the security of your password and all actions taken under your account.
terms.s3Content: We try to describe tea varieties, tableware and sets as accurately as possible, including composition, taste characteristics and brewing method. The actual appearance of the product (packaging color, leaf shade) may slightly differ from the images on the site.
terms.s4Content: An order is considered accepted after confirmation on the site. Prices are indicated in the currency of your region and include applicable taxes. We reserve the right to cancel an order if a price error is found or the item is out of stock, notifying you thereof.
terms.s5Content: Delivery times are approximate and depend on the delivery method and region. The risk of accidental loss or damage to the goods passes to the buyer at the moment the goods are handed over to the carrier.
terms.s6Content: You can return the goods within 14 days of receipt if they have not been used and have retained their original appearance. For hygienic reasons, tea in open packaging cannot be returned or exchanged unless the product is defective.
terms.s7Content: The logo, corporate identity, texts and images on the site belong to Leaf & Cup or are used with the permission of the copyright holders. Copying materials without consent is not permitted.
terms.s8Content: The site is provided 'as is'. We are not liable for indirect damages arising from the use of the site to the extent permitted by applicable law.

catalog.description: The entire Leaf & Cup assortment — tea, cups, teapots, and sets.

product.careText_tea: We recommend water at 85–95°C and brewing for 2–4 minutes — exact parameters depend on the variety and are indicated on the package. Store tea in a dry place without direct light, in a tightly closed container.
product.careText_cups: Hand wash with warm water without harsh detergents. Handmade items may differ slightly in shape and shade from the image — this is part of their character, not a defect.
product.careText_teapots: After brewing, rinse the teapot with warm water without detergent — this way clay and cast iron retain their properties longer. Dry thoroughly before storing.
product.careText_sets: Follow the care instructions for each item in the set: store tea separately from dishes, in a cool, dry place, away from direct light.
product.careText_accessories: Hand wash and dry thoroughly after use. It is not recommended to soak bamboo and wooden items for a long time — this can cause the wood to crack.
product.careText_matcha: Store matcha in the refrigerator in a tightly closed jar — this way the powder retains its color and aroma longer. Sift before whisking to avoid lumps.
product.careText_default: Follow the instructions on the product packaging.
product.shippingText: Delivery times depend on the delivery method and region. You can return the product within 14 days of receipt if it has not been used and has retained its presentation — see more in the terms of use.
